_comment: DRISHTI NoSQL segments (Phase 14 Part B / matrix row 7). NoSQL holds ONLY flexible/ephemeral semi-structured state that is a poor fit for the relational serving layer. It is NEVER a duplicate of authoritative Data Store records and NEVER the system of record for case/FIR/person data. Created in Console -> NoSQL (no CLI). Enabled via DRISHTI_USE_CATALYST_NOSQL.

segments.name: BoardLayout
segments.purpose: Saved investigation-board canvas layout (node positions, groupings).
segments.disposition: RESERVED (disabled scaffold) — owned/enabled by Prompt 16 (Investigation Board).

segments.name: UiPreferences
segments.purpose: Per-user UI preferences (theme, saved filters, column order).
segments.disposition: flexible per-user state; safe to lose

segments.name: Presence
segments.purpose: Who-is-viewing presence markers for collaborative screens.

segments.name: FeedEnvelope
segments.purpose: Flexible envelope for heterogeneous hazard/feed payloads before normalization.
segments.disposition: RESERVED (disabled scaffold) — owned/enabled by Prompt 17 (Disaster Response).

guardrail: Any segment not listed here is rejected by app/nosql.py. Canonical records always live in Data Store.
